framework.summary: Large frontier developers must write, follow and publish a frontier AI framework, and review it at least once a year.
framework.quote: A large frontier developer shall write, implement, comply with, and clearly and conspicuously publish on its internet website a frontier AI framework

transparency_report.summary: Every frontier developer must publish a transparency report when it deploys a new or substantially modified frontier model.
transparency_report.quote: a frontier developer shall clearly and conspicuously publish on its internet website a transparency report

incident_reporting.summary: Critical safety incidents must be reported to the Office of Emergency Services within 15 days of discovery.
incident_reporting.quote: shall report any critical safety incident pertaining to one or more of its frontier models to the Office of Emergency Services within 15 days of discovering the critical safety incident

imminent_risk_reporting.summary: An incident posing an imminent risk of death or serious physical injury must be disclosed to an appropriate authority within 24 hours.
imminent_risk_reporting.quote: poses an imminent risk of death or serious physical injury, the frontier developer shall disclose that incident within 24 hours

third_party_audit.summary: The framework must describe how the developer uses third parties to assess catastrophic risk; no independent audit is required.
third_party_audit.quote: Using third parties to assess the potential for catastrophic risks and the effectiveness of mitigations of catastrophic risks.

whistleblower.summary: Frontier developers may not block or retaliate against employees who report catastrophic-risk dangers or violations of the Act.
whistleblower.quote: A frontier developer shall not make, adopt, enforce, or enter into a rule, regulation, policy, or contract that prevents a covered employee from disclosing, or retaliates against a covered employee for disclosing

registration.summary: The bill sets no registration or licensing requirement.

shutdown.summary: The bill requires no shutdown or kill-switch capability.

compute_threshold.summary: A frontier model is one trained with more than 10^26 operations, counting fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.
compute_threshold.quote: trained using a quantity of computing power greater than 10^26 integer or floating-point operations

revenue_threshold.summary: A large frontier developer has annual gross revenues above $500,000,000, with its affiliates, in the preceding calendar year.
revenue_threshold.quote: annual gross revenues in excess of five hundred million dollars ($500,000,000) in the preceding calendar year

harm_threshold.summary: Catastrophic risk means death or serious injury to more than 50 people, or more than $1,000,000,000 in property damage, from a single incident.
harm_threshold.quote: more than 50 people or more than one billion dollars ($1,000,000,000) in damage to, or loss of, property arising from a single incident

penalties.summary: Civil penalty of up to $1,000,000 per violation, recovered only in a civil action by the Attorney General.
penalties.quote: does not exceed one million dollars ($1,000,000) per violation

effective_date.summary: The bill text states no effective date.
